doc.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Who was drafted and who escaped
summary: They discuss the 18-to-45 draft, his flat feet, and why Bird, Dizzy and Sun Ra did or did not serve.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Yeah, just about everybody that had the sense at all got in the band.
Were they drafting cats like Lester Young’s age? Or just younger?
Yeah, because I was – well, from 18 to 45.
And they didn’t ask you, did you want to go? I told them my feet were flat. They said that makes no difference. Say, “March, brother.”
How did Bird and Dizzy and all of them get out of that? They’re the same age.

I guess they used – well, you know, Sun Ra didn’t go, and his men. So I guess they all knew something. But what they knew, I know I didn’t know it. It’s silly, talking about, “Let’s go. Show me the enemy.”
I don’t think so. Quite a few guys just wasn’t in shape. I told them about my feet, like I said, and they said, oh no.
